summary: Webuy Global Ltd, a Cayman-incorporated, Singapore-based Nasdaq-listed retail group, filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US current report) with inline XBRL covering the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing references subsequent events including share purchases for Webuy Travel Pte Ltd, a Share Purchase Agreement with Dogwood Partners relating to an equity line of credit dated July 23, 2026, and share issuances dated August and September 2026. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or structural mechanics are disclosed in the excerpt. No special-situation event is evidenced; the filing appears to be an ordinary interim report.
